data.desc: Aurelion is a publicly traded company building a digital gold risk and technology infrastructure around XAU, on-chain gold backed by physical LBMA bars. XAU combines the stability of physical gold with the efficiency of blockchain, providing investors access to tokenized gold reserve that could serve as a safe haven to inflation, currency devaluation and crypto volatility. In parallel to building a business around the development of tokenized gold, Aurelion provides wealth management and asset management services.
